phase: frozen before predecessor images, author prose, closure or historical scores
reviewed: Approved original plus candidate hero and all nine raw views, each opened individually
scope: Static visual likeness only; no structural-test credit, gameplay or animation acceptance
observations: Recognizable antlered wood guardian: broad leafy shoulder mantle, cyan eyes/core, hanging arms, bent legs and stony toes.
Reference has heavier root-loop hands and more integrated twisted wood mass; candidate fingers are thin separated hooks and torso is a tidy rib cage.
Face keeps narrow cyan eyes and pointed mask, but is a long smooth planar beak, missing the reference's split layered cheek/jaw structure.
Antlers read clearly but are more balanced lateral deer-like branches than the reference's uneven upright broken tree forks.
Large bright green shoulder chunks read as a canopy, but are chunky geometric caps rather than the reference's overlapping leafy cascades; sides/back remain visibly coherent.
Low-poly planar language is convincing; core has too few very large planes and wooden limbs repeat clean extruded shapes compared with the concept's irregular facet rhythm.
